description: A flyer, pressed into your hand before the shelter door sealed: 'HAVEN IS LIT. The light stays on. 91.1, every night at dusk. Bring what you can carry. Tell them the courier sent you.' On the back, in pencil: 'If the voice ever stops saying the line about the light - run.'
A brass washer stamped with a water drop. Old Tom's mark. 'Micah honors this,' he told you. 'Flash it and he'll know I vouched. Out here trust is the only currency that never lost its value.'

A road map with Lena's grease-pencil route east: rest stops, fuel, and dead zones marked in three colors. 'The tower's lit. The broadcast is real. Follow the 91.1 signal and keep the tank above half. The Long Road starts now - Haven is waiting.' (Act 1 complete. Acts 2-5 continue this route.)

A red folder, heavy for paper. Page nine: 'SPECIMEN 12 ATE SPECIMEN 11. Promising.' Page ten is a shopping list with human growth hormone underlined twice. Whatever Morrow is building in that lab, the word cure is doing a lot of lifting.
A sewn ash-grey patch: a grinning jackal over crossed torches. Kess sewed it on herself. 'Means you bring good fights and read the fine print. Flash it at any Jackal and you're crew.'
